attempts.answer:
The vendor directly providing **Dropbox** at **dropbox.com** is **Dropbox, Inc.** (for users residing in North America) and **Dropbox International Unlimited Company** (for users residing outside North America).

### Official Provider Statement
According to the official **Dropbox Terms of Service** (at `dropbox.com/terms`):
> *"These terms of service (“Terms”) cover your use and access to our services, client software and websites ("Services"). If you reside outside of the United States of America, Canada and Mexico (“North America”) your agreement is with Dropbox International Unlimited Company. If you reside in North America your agreement is with Dropbox, Inc."*
